description: Resolve a Spanish-market issuer name or ISIN to the NIF the CNMV registers use, via the CNMV entity search and ISIN register. Returns the matching entities (name + NIF) and the CNMV entity page URL. Use the NIF with cnmv_search_filings or cnmv_annual_reports.

company.description: Entity name or fragment, e.g. "Tecnicas Reunidas", "Santander".

name: cnmv_find_issuer
title: Cnmv Find Issuer
